items.why: Down over 3% as the AI trade resumes its sell-off, with the Nasdaq falling and investors questioning whether the AI stock boom is over.
Chip names are catching the downdraft from the AI sell-off and a dismal data-center IPO weighing on tech investors.

summary: Tuesday opened soft as the AI sell-off returned, with the Nasdaq down near 1% and big tech leading the slide while the Dow held green.
